Function Name: is_equal_to_sum_even  
Description: Determines whether a given integer n can be written as the sum of exactly four positive even numbers.  
Parameters:  
- n (integer): The number to evaluate. Must be a positive integer.  
Example Usage:  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(8) ➔ true   (because 8 = 2 + 2 + 2 + 2)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(10) ➔ true  (because 10 = 2 + 2 + 2 + 4)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(7) ➔ false  (odd and too small)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(6) ➔ false  (even but less than the minimal sum 8)
